change: Log Breakdown: added a big readable date/time summary line (e.g. '19 Aug 2026, 10:35') above the Date & Time dropdowns, updating live as they change, so the current setting is obvious without reading five separate selects. Also extended Paste WhatsApp Message - Auto Fill to detect a time (HH:MM) and date (DD/MM or DD/MM/YYYY) in the pasted message and fill the Date & Time fields automatically -- previously it left them untouched, always defaulting to 'Now' and forcing a manual edit every time.
